reason: NONE. The first thing I saw was zero reviews, then "Every batch lab-tested" with a QR code, and anyone can print that. I don't buy magnesium without hundreds of reviews I can scan for stomach and fake-dosing complaints, and I look for NSF or USP, which isn't mentioned.
objection: A brand-new listing with no reviews and no NSF or USP seal. A QR code to a batch report is nice, but I can't tell if the lab is real or if the report is for my box. $1 a serving is fine, but I won't be the first review.
would_change_my_mind: NSF or USP certification on the box, plus a few hundred verified reviews with no stomach or dosing complaints. Then I'd try the Bisglycinate.
